landing.title: circloo · your circle, in one private space
landing.headline: Your circle, in one private space.
landing.sub: Check in on how everyone feels, start meetings with a laugh and decide things together. One small private space for your family, your friends or your team.
landing.languagesLine: Speaks English, français, العربية and español.

teaser.title: Today's icebreaker
teaser.answerHint: Stays on your screen. Nothing is sent.
teaser.error: We could not load this card. Deal another one.

feel.title: Feel together
feel.body: One tap in the morning tells your circle how you are. Words and faces, never just colours. A note or a small need if you want, and that is it.
feel.weather: Circle weather: mostly bright, one person needs coffee.
feel.tryIt: Try it: how do you feel?

work.title: Work together
work.body: Live boards for brainstorms, retros and decisions. Stick notes, drag them, vote with dots, watch everyone's cursor move. On a phone or on the big screen.

fun.title: Have fun together
fun.body: Icebreakers, riddles and jokes written by people in each language, never translated by a machine. Want more? Ask circloo for fresh ones that fit your circle, checked for kindness.

integrations.title: Plugs into your week
integrations.body: circloo sends what your circle decides where your team already works. Salesforce is on the way.

items.teams: Start Teams meetings with an icebreaker
items.salesforce: Celebrate the deals your team wins
items.confluence: Publish a board as a page
items.notion: Send boards and notes to your workspace

steps.title: Type your email
steps.body: We send you a six-digit code. No password to remember.

steps.title: Make your circle
steps.body: Family, friends or team. Invite people by email or with a simple code.

steps.title: Get going together
steps.body: Check-ins, icebreakers and boards, all in one place.

final.title: Ready when your circle is.
final.body: Private by default. Only the people you invite can see what happens in your circle.

footer.made: Made for families, friends and teams in four languages.
footer.trademarks: Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence and Notion are trademarks of their owners. circloo is not affiliated with them.

pricing.title: One plan. Everything in it.
pricing.body: No tiers to compare and no feature behind a paywall. Start today, free while circloo is in early access.
features: Fresh AI cards with circloo, checked for kindness
Live rounds with animator and participants
Private by default, no ads, ever
pricing.note: If we ever add a paid plan, we will tell you well before anything is charged. Your circle keeps working.

inside.title: Inside circloo
inside.body: A calm workspace for your circle: live icebreakers, check-ins and boards, with circloo ready to help.

tour.title: circloo in 20 seconds
tour.lead: A circle forms, circloo runs an icebreaker, the team decides on a live board, and the results go to Teams, Jira or Notion.
tour.description: Silent video. The circloo face smiles; eight friends join a circle as characters; circloo asks a question and two people answer; notes and votes fill a Start, Stop, Continue board; results are sent to Teams, Jira and Notion; Pirikoo the parakeet lands next to the face.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lead: Connect the tools your team already uses. Circles can then send their results there.

teams.name: Microsoft Teams
teams.what: Post a circle summary card to a channel.
teams.how: In Teams, open the channel, choose Workflows, pick "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", and paste its URL here.

jira.name: Jira
jira.what: Turn the top-voted action notes into tasks.
jira.how: Create an API token in your Atlassian account (Security, API tokens) and pick the project for the tasks.

confluence.name: Confluence
confluence.what: Publish the circle as a page in a space.
confluence.how: Use an Atlassian API token and the numeric id of the space (Space settings or the REST API).

notion.name: Notion
notion.what: Write the circle as a page in your workspace.
notion.how: Create an internal integration in Notion (Settings, Connections), share the parent page with it, then paste its secret and the page link.
